notes: Opt-in CPU Q8 and 20480-wide HC arithmetic replay modes, fused HC RMS, CPU RoPE FMA and refined Vulkan scalar RMS were investigated and removed after failing strict model parity.
Vulkan quantized projections switch above 16 rows from 32-element dot/tree GEMV to sequential GEMM. Replaying this order makes the same-input batch-32 Q8 KV projection bit-identical.

The original precise-rms shader used unsupported GLSL precise syntax and fell back to CPU. Those results are invalid GPU arithmetic evidence. The initial fp64-rms literal was also rejected; trace-probe.log records that error. The corrected FP64 shader subsequently ran with zero CPU fallbacks.

Native FP64 scalar RMS refinement plus matching prefill order makes the first-layer cached keys and dot scores bit-identical; the next difference is the attention exponential, maximum 5.96046448e-8. Subsequent CPU and Vulkan reduction/elementwise differences still violate full-model parity.

At decode position 124 layer 3, CPU selected expert 88 instead of Vulkan expert 245. FP64 dot/scoring from either captured input selects 245; adding the large common router bias in FP32 collapses the CPU selection pair to a tie. No router bias normalization or routing change was enabled.
All captures and prototype timings are diagnostic, with some reused references and builds running concurrently. None are speed or memory certification.
